## Platform Assurance
- **Cryptographic Posture & Post-Quantum Readiness**: https://bidda.com/cryptographic-posture
  Content integrity and the tamper-evident record log are hash-based (SHA-256, RFC 6962) and are not broken by quantum computers. Transport negotiates hybrid post-quantum key agreement (X25519MLKEM768, FIPS 203 ML-KEM-768) today. Record signatures are Ed25519 and are on a stated hybrid migration path. Bidda does not describe itself as a quantum-safe platform.
- **Verify Node Integrity**: https://bidda.com/verify
- **Transparency Log**: https://bidda.com/transparency
